ἐπί.g: on, to, against, on the basis of, at
ἐπί.long: on, to, against, on the basis of, at.
ἐπί.sd: properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.
ἐπί.kj: about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with
ἐπί.as:
ἐπί (before a smooth breathing ἐπ’, before a rough breathing ἐφ’),
prep. c. gen., dat., acc. (acc. most freq. in NT),
with primary sense of superposition, on, upon.
I. C. gen.,
1. of place, answering the question, where?
(a) of the place on which, on, upon: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, Mt 6:10, 19, al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, I Co 11:10; τ. νεφελῶν, Mt 24:30, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, Mk 4:26; σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, He 6:7, al.; fig., ἐπ’ ἀληθείας (MM, s.v. ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, Ga 3:16; of power or authority, over, πάντων, Ro 9:5: τ. γάζης, Ac 8:27; ἐξουσία, Re 2:2620:6;
(b) of vicinity, at, by: τ. θαλάσσης, Jo 6:9; τ. ὁδοῦ, Mt 21:19; τοῦ βάτου, Mk 12:26 (v. Swete, in l.); c. gen. pers., in the presence of, before, Mt 28:14, Ac 23:30, I Co 6:1, al.
2. Of time,
(a) c. gen. pers., in the time of: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, Lk 4:27; ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, Ac 11:28; ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, when A. was high priest, Mk 2:26;
(b) c. gen. rei, at, at the time of: Mt 1:11, He 1:2, II Pe 3:3; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, Ro 1:10, Eph 1:16, I Th 1:2, Phm 4.
II. C. dat., of place, answering the question, where?
(a) lit., on, upon: Mt 9:16, 14:8, al.; after verbs of motion (v. supr., I, 1, (a)), Mt 9:16Ac 8:16; above, Lk 23:38; at, by, Mk 13:29, Jo 5:2, Ac 5:9, al.;
(b) metaph., upon, on the ground of, Lk 4:4(LXX); in the matter of, Mk 6:52 (v. Swete, in l.); upon, of, concerning, Ac 5:35, 40; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), Mt 18:319:9, Ro 12:12, al.; ἐφ’ ᾧ, for the reason that, because, Ro 5:12II Co 5:4; after verbs of motion, over, Mt 18:13, Ro 16:19, al.; of a condition (cl.), Ro 8:20, I Co 9:10; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (v. Westc. on He 9:10), He 10:28; of purpose or aim, Eph 2:10, Phl 4:10; of authority, over, Mt 24:47Lk 12:44; of hostility, c. dat. pers. (cl.), against, Lk 12:52; in addition to (cl.), II Co 7:13; of an adjunct, in, at, on, Phl 1:32:17.
III. C. acc.,
1. of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither?
(a) lit., upon, over: Mt 14:28, 29, Lk 5:19, al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as c. gen., dat.), Mk 4:3811:2, Lk 2:25, Jo 1:32; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, Ac 1:152:1, al.; of motion to a vicinity, to, Mk 16:2, Ac 8:36, al.;
(b) metaph. (in wh. "the acc. is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, c. acc. pers., Mt 10:1312:28, Ac 2:17, Jo 18:4, Eph 5:6, al.; of addition (dat. in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, Phl 2:27; ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (v.s. ἐπικαλέω), Ac 15:17, Ja 2:7; καλεῖν ἐπί, to call after, Lk 1:59; of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), thrice, Ac 10:1611:10; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, the more, further, Ac 4:17II Ti 2:163:9 (v. also infr., 2, (a)); ἐφ’ ὅσον (v. infr., ib.), forasmuch as, Mt 25:40, 45, Ro 11:13; of power, authority, control, Lk 1:33, Ac 7:10Ro 5:14, He 3:6, al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, unto, towards, Lk 1:1723:28, Ac 9:35, 42, Ro 11:22, Ga 4:9, Eph 2:7, I Ti 5:5, al.; of purpose, for, Mt 3:7, Lk 23:48; ἐφ’ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ’ ᾧ, Mt 26:50; of hostility, against, Mt 24:7, Mk 3:24-2610:1113:8, Lk 9:5, Jo 13:18, Ac 7:54, I Co 7:36, II Co 1:23; Of reference, concerning, for (cl. usually dat.), Mk 9:1215:24, Jo 19:24, Ro 4:9.
2. Of time,
(a)during, for: Lk 4:25 (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), Ac 13:3116:18, He 11:30, al.; ἐφ’ ὅσον (χρόνον), as long as, for so long time as, Mk 9:15Ro 7:1, al. (for ἐφ’ ὅ in another sense, v. supr., 1, (b)); ἐφ’ ἱκανόν (v.s. ἱ), Ac 20:11; ἐπὶ πλεῖον (v. supr., 1, (b)), yet longer, further, Ac 20:924:4;
(b)on, about, towards (cl. εἰς): Lk 10:35Ac 3:14:5.
IV. In composition, ἐπί signifies: up, ἐπαίρω; upon, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ἐπικαθίζω; towards, επιβλέπω, ἐπεκτείνω; over (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; again, in addition, ἐπαιτέω; against, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή.

ἐπάν.sd: a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as
ἐπάν.as:
† ἐπ-άν
conj.
(< ἐπεί, q.v., ἄν)
later form of ἐπήν,
after, when: c. subjc. Pres., Lk 11:34; c. subjc. aor., Mt 2:8, Lk 11:22.†

ἐπάνω.g: on the top, above, superior to
ἐπάνω.long: (a) adv: on the top, above, (b) prep: on the top of, above, over, on, above, more than, superior to.
ἐπάνω.sd: up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.)
ἐπάνω.as:
ἐπ-άνω
adv.,
[in LXX for מַעֲלָה, עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;]
above;
1. adverbially;
(a) of place: Lk 11:44;
(b) of number, more than: Mk 14:5, I Co 15:6.
2. As prep. c. gen.;
(a) of place: Mt 2:95:1421:723:18, 20, 2227:3728:2, Lk 4:3910:19, Re 6:820:3;
(b) of pre-eminence: Lk 19:17, 19, Jo 3:31.†

ἐπιθυμέω.g: I long for, covet, lust after
ἐπιθυμέω.long: I long for, covet, lust after, set the heart upon.
ἐπιθυμέω.sd: to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise)
ἐπιθυμέω.as:
ἐπιθυμέω, -ῶ
(< θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;]
to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., Ja 4:2, Ro 7:713:9(LXX), I Co 10:6 (of. IV Mac 2:6); seq. κατά (against, in opposition to), Ga 5:17; prop. (as in cl.) c. gen., Ac 20:33, I Ti 3:1; in late Gk. also c. acc (M, Pr., 65), Mt 5:28 (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. Ex 20:17, Mi 2:2, Wi 16:3, al.); c. inf., Mt 13:17, Lk 15:1616:2117:22, I Pe 1:12, Re 9:6; c. acc et inf., He 6:11; as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, Lk 22:15.†
SYN.: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, Notes, 204), θέλω (DCG. i, 453a)

ἐπιορκέω.g: I take an oath, swear falsely
ἐπιορκέω.long: I take an oath, swear falsely.
ἐπιορκέω.as:
** ἐπιορκέω, -ῶ
(< ἐπίορκος), [in LXX: I Es 1:48, Wi 14:28 * ;]
to swear falsely, forswear oneself: Mt 5:33.†

ἐπιούσιος.sd: tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510 (εἰμί); for subsistence, i.e. needful
ἐπιούσιος.der: perhaps from the same as G1966 (ἐπιοῦσα);
ἐπιούσιος.as:
*† ἐπιούσιος, -ον
(cf. περιούσιος, [in LXX for סְגֻלָּה, De 7:6, etc.]),
found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., for the coming day: Mt 6:11, Lk 11:3. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning.
1. < ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, < ἐπὶτὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, s.v.), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.).
2.
(a) < ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.);
(b) < ἐπί + εἶναι in fem. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, v. reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.c. The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (ICC on Mt, l.c.; cf. also Cremer, 239).†

ἐπιζητέω.g: I seek after, desire, search for
ἐπιζητέω.long: I seek after, desire, search for, make inquiries about.
ἐπιζητέω.sd: to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave
ἐπιζητέω.as:
ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, IV Ki 8:8, Is 62:12, al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, I Ki 20:1, Ec 7:29(28)), Ho 3:5; פָּקַד, IV Ki 3:8 ;]
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv),
to inquire for, seek after, wish for: c. acc rei, Mt 6:3212:3916:4, Lk 12:30, Ac 19:39, Ro 11:7, Phl 4:17, He 11:1413:14; c. acc pers., Lk 4:42, Ac 12:19; c. inf., Ac 13:7.†

ἐπιδίδωμι.g: I hand in, give up, give way
ἐπιδίδωμι.long: (a) trans: I hand in, give up, (b) intrans: I give way (to the wind).
ἐπιδίδωμι.sd: to give over (by hand or surrender)
ἐπιδίδωμι.kj: deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer
ἐπιδίδωμι.as:
ἐπι-δίδωμι
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
1.to give over, to hand: c. acc rei et dat. pers., Mt 7:9, 10, Lk 11:11, 1224:30, 42, Ac 15:30; pass. c. dat. pers., Lk 4:17.
2.to give in, give way: absol., Ac 27:15.†

ἐπιγινώσκω.g: I come to know, discern, recognize
ἐπιγινώσκω.long: I come to know by directing my attention to him or it, I perceive, discern, recognize; aor: I found out.
ἐπιγινώσκω.sd: to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge
ἐπιγινώσκω.as:
ἐπι-γινώσκω
[in LXX chiefly for נָכַר: hi., also for יָדַע, etc. ;]
"directive" of γινώσκω (AR, Eph., 249), as in cl.;
1.to observe, perceive, discern, recognize;
(a) absol.: Ac 25:10, I Co 13:12; seq. ὅτι, Lk 1:22; τ. πνεύματι, seq. ὅτι, Mk 2:8;
(b) c. acc rei: Lk 1:45:22, Ac 12:1427:39, Ro 1:32, II Co 1:13, Col 1:6, I Ti 4:3; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, Mk 5:30; seq. ὅτι, I Co 14:37;
(c) c. acc pers.: Mt 11:2714:3517:12, Mk 6:33 (T, αὐτούς, but LTr., WH, R, omit the pron., and LTr., WH, txt., read ἔγνωσαν), ib. 54, Lk 24:16, 31, I Co 16:18, II Co 1:14; seq. ἀπό, c. gen. rei, Mt 7:16, 20; seq. ὅτι, Ac 3:104:13, II Co 13:5; pass., I Co 13:12; opp. to ἀγνοούμενοι, II Co 6:9.
2.to discover, ascertain, determine: Ac 9:30; seq. ὅτι, Lk 7:3723:7, Ac 19:3422:2924:1128:1; c. acc rei, seq. quæst., Ac 23:28; δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν, Ac 22:24; παρά, c. gen. pers., seq. περί, c. gen. rei, Ac 24:8; τ. ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, II Pe 2:21 (cf. Lft., Col., 136; Cremer, 159; M, Pr., 113; AR, Eph., 248 ff.).†

ἐπιτρέπω.long: I turn to, commit, entrust; I allow, yield, permit.
ἐπιτρέπω.kj: give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer
ἐπιτρέπω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
ἐπιτρέπω.as:
ἐπι-τρέπω
[in LXX (usually with v.l. ἐπιστρ-): Ge 39:6 (עָזַב), etc. ;]
1.to turn to, commit, entrust.
2.to yield, permit: I Co 16:7, He 6:3; c. dat. pers., Mk 5:13, Jo 19:38; id. c. inf. (cf. M, Pr., 205), Mt 8:2119:8, Lk 8:329:52, 61Ac 21:39, 4027:3, I Ti 2:12; c. inf., Mk 10:4. Pass., c. dat. et inf., Ac 26:128:16, I Co 14:34.†

ἐπιτιμάω.long: (a) I rebuke, chide, admonish, (b) I warn.
ἐπιτιμάω.sd: to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid
ἐπιτιμάω.as:
ἐπι-τιμάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for גָּעַר, Ge 37:10, Ps 9:5, Za 3:3(2); Si 11:7, al. ;]
1.to honour.
2.to raise in price
3.to mete out due measure;
(a)to award;
(b)to censure, rebuke, admonish: absol., II Ti 4:2; c. dat., Mt 8:2617:1319:13, Mk 4:398:3210:13, Lk 4:39, 418:249:21, 42, 5517:318:1519:39, Ju 9; seq. ἵνα, Mt 12:1616:2020:31, Mk 3:128:3010:48, Lk 18:39; seq. λέγων, λέγει, etc., Mt 16:22, Mk 1:258:339:25, Lk 4:3523:40.†
SYN.: ἐλέγχω, q.v

ἐπιβάλλω.g: I throw upon, lay, strike upon
ἐπιβάλλω.long: (a) I throw upon, cast over, (b) I place upon, (c) I lay, (d) intrans: I strike upon, rush.
ἐπιβάλλω.sd: to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with G1438 (ἑαυτοῦ) implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to
ἐπιβάλλω.kj: beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on
ἐπιβάλλω.as:
ἐπι-βάλλω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;]
1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: c. acc et dat., Mk 11:7, I Co 7:35; c. acc, seq. ἐπί c. acc, Re 18:19, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, Mt 26:50, Lk 20:1921:12, Jo 7:30, Ac 5:1821:27; c. dat. (Polyb.), Mk 14:46Ac 4:3; c. inf., Ac 12:1; τὴν χ. ἐπ’ ἄροτρον, Lk 9:62; ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, Lk 5:36; ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, Mt 9:16.
2. Intrans.,
(a)to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mk 4:37; metaph., to put one's mind upon (but v. Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), he wept (EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, Pr., 131): Mk 14:72 (v. also Swete, in l);
(b)to fall to one's share: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dat.; Hdt., a1., a technical formula freq. in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, LAE, 152), Lk 15:12.†

ἐπίβλημα.as:
ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Is 3:22 * ;]
1.that which is thrown over, a cover.
2.a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.c.).
3.that which is put on;
(a)embroidery;
(b)a patch: Mt 9:16, Mk 2:21, Lk 5:36.†

ἐπιτίθημι.g: I put, place upon, lay on
ἐπιτίθημι.long: I put, place upon, lay on; I add, give in addition.
ἐπιτίθημι.sd: to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense)
ἐπιτίθημι.kj: add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound
ἐπιτίθημι.as:
ἐπι-τίθημι
[in LXX for נָתַן, שָׁוָה, etc. ;]
1.to lay, set or place upon: c. acc rei, seq. ἐπί, c. acc rei, Mt 23:4, Lk 15:5, Jo 9:6 (WH, txt.), 15, Ac 15:1028:3; ἐπί, c. gen. rei, Mt 27:29; ἐν, ib.; c. dat. pers., σταυρόν, Lk 23:26; στέφανον, Jo 19:2; ὄνομα, Mk 3:16, 17; πληγάς, Lk 10:30, Ac 16:23; ἐπί c. acc pers., Re 22:18; of the laying on of hands, τ. χεῖρα (-ας), seq. ἐπί c. acc pers., Mt 9:18, Mk 16:[18], Ac 8:179:17; c. dat. pers., Mt 19:13, 15, Mk 5:236:57:328:23, Lk 4:4013:13, Ac 6:68:199:1213:319:628:8, I Ti 5:22. Mid.,
(a)to provide: Ac 28:10 (RV, put on board; cf. Field, Notes, 149);
(b)to throw oneself upon, attack: c. dat. pers., Ac 18:10.
2.to add to: Re 22:18 (v. supr., and cf. Swete, in l.).†

ἐπιστρέφω.long: (a) trans: I turn (back) to (towards), (b) intrans: I turn (back) (to [towards]); I come to myself.
ἐπιστρέφω.as:
ἐπι-στρέφω
[very freq. in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaph., to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): Lk 1:16, 17 (cf. Ma 3:24), Ja 5:19, 20.
2. Intrans.,
(a)to turn, turn oneself around: Ac 16:18; c. inf., Re 1:12; seq. πρός, Ac 9:40; so also pass. (cl.), Mk 5:308:33, Jo 21:20; metaph., of turning to God (v. Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), Ac 9:3511:2114:1515:1926:20; πρὸς τ. θεόν, I Th 1:9, II Co 3:16; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, Ac 26:18; pass., I Pe 2:25;
(b)to return (as in MGr.): Lk 8:55, Ac 15:36; seq. ὀπίσω, c. inf., Mt 24:18; seq. εἰς, Mt 12:44, Mk 13:16, Lk 2:3917:31; ἐπί, II Pe 2:22; metaph., seq. ἐπί, Ga 4:9; πρός, Lk 17:4; of moral reform, Mt 13:15, Mk 4:12, Lk 22:32, Ac 3:1928:27; pass., Mt 10:13 (Cremer, 531, 881).†

ἐπανίσταμαι.long: intrans. tenses: I rise up against.
ἐπανίσταμαι.sd: to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack
ἐπανίσταμαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G450 (ἀνίστημι);
ἐπανίσταμαι.as:
ἐπ-αν-ίστημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
to raise up against; mid., to rise up against: seq. ἐπί, c. acc pers., Mt 10:21, Mk 13:12.†

ἐπικαλέω.g: I call by an additional name, appeal to
ἐπικαλέω.long: (a) I call (name) by a supplementary (additional, alternative) name, (b) mid: I call upon, appeal to, address.
ἐπικαλέω.sd: to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.)
ἐπικαλέω.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2564 (καλέω);
ἐπικαλέω.as:
ἐπι-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
1.to call, name, surname: c. acc (cl.), Mt 10:25; pass., Ac 1:234:3610:5, 18, 3211:1312:12, 25, He 11:16; τ. ὄνομα, seq. ἐπί (denoting possession, as Heb.. עַלנִקְרָאשֵׁם .), Ac 15:17(LXX), Ja 2:7 (see. CB on Am 9:12).
2. Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), to call upon, invoke, appeal to (θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., LAE, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, Ac 25:25), Ac 25:11, 12, 2126:3228:19; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, Ac 7:59; μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, II Co 1:23; πατέρα, I Pe 1:17; τ. κύριον, Ro 10:12, II Ti 2:22; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like Heb.בְּשֵׁםיְהֹוָהקָרָא ), Ac 2:21(LXX)Ac 9:14, 2122:16, Ro 10:13, 14(LXX)I Co 1:2 (Cremer, 335, 742).†

ἐπερωτάω.sd: to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek
ἐπερωτάω.as:
ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;]
1.to in­quire of, consult, question: c. acc pers., Mk 12:34, Lk 2:46, al.; c. dupl. acc, Mk 7:1711:29, Lk 20:40, al.; c. acc pers., seq. λέγων, Mt 12:18, Mk 9:11; εἰ, Mk 8:23, Lk 23:6, al.; ἐ. θεόν, Ro 10:20(LXX).
2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: c. acc pers. et inf., Mt 16:1 (cf. ἐρωτάω; and v. Cromer, 716)

ἑπτά.as:
ἑπτά, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
seven: Mt 12:4518:22 (cf. ἑβδομηκοντάκις), Mk 8:5, al.; οἱ ἑ, Ac 21:8

ἐπισπείρω.as:
* ἐπι-σπείρω,
to sow upon or besides: ἀνὰ μέσον, Mt 13:25.†

ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.long: I lay hold of, take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).
ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.sd: to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively)
ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.kj: catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on)
ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.as:
ἐπι-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for חָזַק hi., אָחַז, etc. ;]
always mid. in LXX and NT (v. Cremer, 758), to lay hold of: c. gen. pers., Mt 14:31, Ac 17:1921:30, 33; c. acc pers. (not cl.), Lk 9:4714:423:26 (WH, but v. Bl., 1015), Ac 9:2716:918:17; c. gen. rei, Mk 8:23, Ac 23:19, He 8:9(LXX); c. gen. pers. et rei, Lk 20:20, 26; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, I Ti 6:12, 19. Metaph. (as in Si 4:11), He 2:16 (v. Westc., in l.).†

ἐπιδείκνυμι.long: I show, display, point out, indicate; I prove, demonstrate.
ἐπιδείκνυμι.as:
ἐπι-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Pr 12:17 (פּוּחַ hi.), Is 37:26 (בּוֹא hi.), Ep. Jer 59, II Mac 15:32, al ;]
1.to show, exhibit, display: c. acc et dat., Mt 16:122:1924:1, Lk 17:14. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. Bl., § 55, 1): Ac 9:39.
2.to show, point out, prove: c. acc, He 6:17; c. acc et inf., Ac 18:28 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπιλανθάνομαι.sd: to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect
ἐπιλανθάνομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2990 (λανθάνω);
ἐπιλανθάνομαι.as:
ἐπι-λανθάνομαι
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;]
to forget, neglect: c. inf., Mt 16:5, Mk 8:14; c. gen., He 6:1013:2, 16; c. acc (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), Phl 3:13; ὁποῖος ἦν, Ja 1:24; pass. ptcp. (cf. Is 23:16, Si 3:1423:14, Wi 2:4), Lk 12:6.†

ἐπισκιάζω.sd: to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence
ἐπισκιάζω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);
ἐπισκιάζω.as:
ἐπι-σκιάζω
[in LXX: Ex 40:29(35) (שָׁכַן), Ps 90(91):4139(140):7 (סָכַךְ), Pr 18:11 * ;]
to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: c. dat., Ac 5:15; of a shining (Mt, l.c., and cf. Ex 40:29, 35, II Mac 2:8) cloud, c. dat., Mk 9:7; c. acc, Mt 17:5, Lk 9:34; metaph. (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.c.), of the Holy Spirit, Lk 1:35.†

ἐπαίρω.as:
ἐπ-αίρω
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, רוּם, etc. ;]
to lift up, raise: τ. ἀρτέμονα, Ac 27:40; χεῖρας, Lk 24:50, I Ti 2:8; κεφαλάς, Lk 21:28; ὀφθαλμούς, Mt 17:8, Lk 6:2016:2318:13, Jo 4:356:517:1; φωνήν, Lk 11:27, Ac 2:1414:1122:22; τ. πτέρναν (fig.), Jo 13:18. Pass., Ac 1:9; metaph., to be lifted up with pride: II Co 10:511:20.†

ἐπεί.long: of time: when, after; of cause: since, because; otherwise: else.
ἐπεί.sd: thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause)
ἐπεί.kj: because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when
ἐπεί.as:
ἐπεί
conj. (ἐπί, εἰ),
when, since;
1. of time, when, after: Lk 7:1 (Rec., WH, mg.).
2. Of cause, since, because: Mt 18:3221:4627:6, Mk 15:42, Lk 1:34, Jo 13:2919:31, Ac 13:46 (Rec., WH, mg.), I Co 14:12, II Co 11:1813:3, He 5:2, 116:139:1711:11; ἐ. οὖν, He 2:144:6. With ellipsis, otherwise, else: Ro 11:6, 22, He 9:26; ἐ. ἄρα, I Co 5:107:14; introducing a question, Ro 3:6, I Co 14:1615:29, He 10:2 (cf. IV Mac 1:332:72:104:24, 26).†

ἐπίτροπος.long: (a) (procurator) a steward, (b) (tutor) a guardian (appointed for an "infant" [under 14 perhaps] by the father or by a magistrate).
ἐπίτροπος.sd: a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian
ἐπίτροπος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5158 (τρόπος) (in the sense of G2011 (ἐπιτροπή));
ἐπίτροπος.as:
** ἐπίτροπος, -ου, ὁ
(< ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: II Mac 11:113:214:2 * ;]
1.an administrator, a steward: Mt 20:8, Lk 8:3.
2.a guardian (c. gen. pers., II Mac, ll. c.): Ga 4:2.†

ἐπιβαίνω.long: (a) I set foot on, step on, (b) I mount (a horse), board (a vessel).
ἐπιβαίνω.sd: to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive
ἐπιβαίνω.kj: come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship
ἐπιβαίνω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
ἐπιβαίνω.as:
ἐπι-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;]
1.to get up on, mount: seq. ἐπί, c. acc, Mt 21:5(LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: c. dat., Ac 27:2; seq. εἰς, Ac 21:6 (Rec.); absol., Ac 21:2.
2.to go up to, go on to, enter: seq. εἰς, Ac 20:1821:4; c. dat., Ac 25:1.†

ἐπικαθίζω.long: I sit upon, cause to sit upon.
ἐπικαθίζω.as:
ἐπι-καθ-ίζω
[in LXX for רָכַב, etc. ;]
to sit upon: Mt 21:7.†

ἐπανάγω.long: (a) nautical: I put out (from the shore), (lit: I take up a ship on to the high seas), (b) I go up, possibly: I go up again, return.
ἐπανάγω.sd: to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return
ἐπανάγω.as:
ἐπ-αν-άγω
[in LXX: Za 4:12 (רוּק hi.), Si 17:2626:28, II Mac 9:2112:4 * ;]
to bring up or back (sc. ναῦς); to put out to sea (DB, iii, 63b): Lk 5:3, 4; intrans., to return: Mt 21:18.†

ἐπιγραφή.as:
* ἐπι-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐπιγράφω),
an inscription: Mt 22:20, Mk 12:1615:26, Lk 20:2423:38.†

ἐπιγαμβρεύω.g: I marry a deceased brother's wife
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.long: I take to wife after, marry a deceased brother's wife.
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.sd: to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G1062 (γάμος);
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.as:
† ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
(< γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Ge 34:9, I Ki 18:21ff., II Ch 18:1, Es 9:14 (חָתַן hithp.), Ge 38:8 R (יָבַם pi.), I Mac 10:54, 56 * ;]
1.to enter into affinity with: c. dat. (LXX, ll. c., exc. Ge 38:8).
2.to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Ge 38:8): c. acc, Mt 22:24.†

ἐπισυνάγω.sd: to collect upon the same place
ἐπισυνάγω.as:
* ἐπι-συν-άγω
[in LXX for אָסַף, קָבַץ, etc. (Cremer, 65) ;]
1.to gather together: Mt 23:3724:31, Mk 13:27, Lk 13:34; pass., Mk 1:33, Lk 12:117:37, (cf. Ps 101 (102):23105 (106):47, II Mac 1:27, al.).
2.to gather together against (Mi 4:11, Za 12:3, I Mac 3:58, al.).†

ἐπισκέπτομαι.g: I look upon, visit, look out, select
ἐπισκέπτομαι.long: I look upon, visit, look out, select.
ἐπισκέπτομαι.sd: to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve
ἐπισκέπτομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4649 (σκοπός);
ἐπισκέπτομαι.as:
ἐπι-σκέπτομαι
(late form of ἐπισκοπέω, q.v.), [in LXX very freq., chiefly for פָּקַד ;]
1.to inspect, examine.
2. (a) to visit: c. acc, Ac 7:2315:36 (cf. Jg 15:1); especially, the sick and afflicted (as in MGr. and sometimes in cl.), Mt 25:36, 43, Ja 1:27 (cf. Si 7:35);
(b) in LXX and NT (as פָּקַד in Ge 21:1, Ex 4:31, Ps 8:5, al.), to visit with help, to care for: Lk 1:68, 787:16, Ac 15:14, He 2:6;
(c)to visit with punishment (Je 9:25, Ps 88(89):33, al.; cf. MM, Exp., xiv; Cremer, 863).†

ἐπίσημος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and some form of the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);
ἐπίσημος.as:
ἐπίσημος, -ον
(< σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Ge 30:42 (קָשַׁר), Es 5:48:13, I Mac 11:3714:48, II Mac 15:36, III Mac 6:1 * ;]
1.bearing a mark; of money, stamped, coined.
2. Metaph.,
(a) in good sense, notable, illustrious: Ro 16:7;
(b) in bad sense, notorious: Mt 27:16.†

ἐπαύριον.sd: occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (G2250 (ἡμέρα) being implied) to-morrow
ἐπαύριον.as:
† ἐπ-αύριον,
adv.
[in LXX for מָחָר, Ge 30:33, elsewhere, Ex 9:6, al., for מׇחֳרָת ;]
on the morrow: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Mt 27:62, Mk 11:12, Jo 1:29, Ac 10:9, al

ἐπιφώσκω.kj: begin to dawn, X draw on
ἐπιφώσκω.as:
ἐπι-φώσκω
[in LXX for הָלַל hi., Jb 41:18 A (Bא, ἐπιφαύσκ-) * ;]
1.to let shine.
2.to dawn (cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Lk 23:54; seq. εἰς, Mt 28:1.†

ἐπιτάσσω.as:
ἐπι-τάσσω
[in LXX for אָמַר, צָוָה, etc. ;]
to command, charge: c. acc rei, Lk 14:22; c. dat. pers., Mk 1:279:25, Lk 4:368:25; id. c. acc rei, Phm 8; id. c. inf., Mk 6:39, Lk 8:31, Ac 23:2; id. c. imperat., Mk 9:25; c. acc et inf., Mk 6:27.†
SYN.: κελεύω

ἐπιράπτω.sd: to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle
ἐπιράπτω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4476 (ῥαφίς);
ἐπιράπτω.as:
*† ἐπι-ράπτω (Rec. -ρράπτω),
to sew upon: seq. ἐπί, c. acc, Mk 2:21.†

ἐπιπίπτω.long: I fall upon, press upon, light upon, come over.
ἐπιπίπτω.sd: to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively)
ἐπιπίπτω.kj: fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon
ἐπιπίπτω.as:
ἐπι-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall upon (Field, Notes, 25): c. dat. pers., Mk 3:10 (v. Swete, in l), Ac 20:10; seq. ἐπὶ τ. τράχηλον (as Ge 46:29, To 11:8, III Mac 5:49, al.), Lk 15:20, Ac 20:37. Metaph., φόβος, Lk 1:12, Ac 19:17, Re 11:11; ὀνειδισμοί, Ro 15:3(LXX); of the Holy Spirit: seq. ἐπί, c. dat., Ac 8:16; ἐπί, c. acc, Ac 10:4411:15; absol., Ac 23:7.†

ἐπιθυμία.g: desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust
ἐπιθυμία.long: desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust.
ἐπιθυμία.sd: a longing (especially for what is forbidden)
ἐπιθυμία.as:
ἐπιθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(< έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חָמוּד, etc. ;]
desire, longing: Lk 22:15 (v.s. ἐπιθυμέω), Phl 1:23, I Th 2:17, Re 18:14; p1., Mk 4:19; esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): Ro 7:7, 8, Ja 1:14, 15, II Pe 1:4; pl., Ga 5:24, I Ti 6:9, II Ti 2:224:3, I Pe 1:144:2; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, I Th 4:5; ἐ. κακή, Col 3:5; c. gen., μιασμοῦ, II Pe 2:10 (v. Mayor, in l.); τ. καρδιῶν, Ro 1:24; τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), I Jo 2:17; τ. σώματος, Ro 6:12; τ. ἀπάτης, Eph 4:22 (v. ICC, in l.); τ. σαρκός, I Jo 2:16, II Pe 2:18 (without art.), Ga 5:16; τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, I Jo 2:16; σαρκικαὶ ἐ., I Pe 2:11 (cf. IV Mac 1:32); κοσμικαί, Tit 2:12; εἰς ἐπιθυμίας, Ro 13:14; ποιεῖν τὰς ἐ., Jo 8:44; ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐ., Ro 6:12; δουλεύειν, ἄγεσθαι, ἐπιθυμίαις, Tit 3:3, II Ti 3:6; πορεύειθαι ἐν ἐ., I Pe 4:3; κατά, Ju 16, 18, II Pe 3:3; ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐ., Eph 2:3.†
SYN.: πάθος (q.v.), ὄρεξις

ἐπιλύω.long: I loose, release; I solve, settle, explain, interpret, decide.
ἐπιλύω.sd: to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide
ἐπιλύω.as:
** ἐπι-λύω
[in Aq.: Ge 40:841:8, 12; Th.: Ho 3:4 * ;]
1.to loose, release.
2.to solve, settle, explain: Mk 4:34, Ac 19:39.†

ἐπαισχύνομαι.long: I am ashamed, am ashamed of.
ἐπαισχύνομαι.as:
ἐπ-αισχύνομαι
[in LXX: Jb 34:19 (נָשָׂא), Ps 118(119):6 (בּוּשׁ), Is 1:29 A (חָפֵר) * ;]
to be ashamed (of): absol., II Ti 1:12; c. acc pers., Mk 8:38, Lk 9:26; c. acc rei, Ro 1:16, II Ti 1:8, 16; ἐπί, c. dat. rei, Ro 6:21; c. inf., He 2:11; c, acc pers, et inf., He 11:16,†

ἐπισυντρέχω.sd: to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion)
ἐπισυντρέχω.as:
† ἐπι-συν-τρέχω
to run together again: Mk 9:25 (v. Swete, in l.).†

ἐπαγγέλλομαι.sd: to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself
ἐπαγγέλλομαι.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);
ἐπαγγέλλομαι.as:
ἐπ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX: Es 4:8 (אָמַר), Pr 13:12, Wi 2:13, al. ;]
1.to announce, proclaim.
2.
(a)to promise;
(b)to profess. Mid., also freq. in both these senses;
(c)to promise: c. dat. pers., He 6:13; c. acc rei, Ro 4:21, Tit 1:2; c. dat pers. et acc rei, Ja 1:122:5, II Pe 2:19; ἐπαγγελίαν, I Jo 2:25; c. inf., Mk 14:11, Ac 7:5; seq. λέγων, He 12:26; ptcp., He 10:2311:11;
(d)to profess: θεοσέβειαν, I Ti 2:10; γνῶσιν, I Ti 6:21. Pass., Ga 3:19 (cf. προ-επαγγέλλω; and v. Cremer, 26).†

ἐπίσταμαι.sd: to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with
ἐπίσταμαι.der: apparently a middle voice of G2186 (ἐφίστημι) (with G3563 (νοῦς) implied);
ἐπίσταμαι.as:
ἐπίσταμαι
(prob. an old mid, of ἐφίστημι, q.v.), [in LXX chiefly for יָדַע ;]
to know, know of, understand: c. acc pers., Ac 19:15; c. ptcp., ib. 24:10; c. acc rei, Mk 14:68, Ac 18:25, I Ti 6:4, Ja 4:14, Ju 10; seq. περί, Ac 26:26; ὅτι, ib. 15:719:2522:19; ὡς, ib. 10:28; πῶς, ib. 20:18; ποῦ, He 11:8.†
SYN: γινώσκω (q.v.), οἶδα

ἐπιγράφω.long: I write upon, inscribe, imprint a mark on.
ἐπιγράφω.as:
ἐπι-γράφω
[in LXX for כָּתַב, Nu 17:2 (17); fig., Je 38(31):33, al. ;]
to write upon, inscribe: Mk 15:26, Ac 17:23, Re 21:12; fig., He 8:10(LXX)He 10:16(ib).†

ἐπακολουθέω.long: I follow close after, accompany, dog; I imitate, pursue, am studious of.
ἐπακολουθέω.as:
ἐπ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX (chiefly metaph.) for אָחַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to follow after; in NT metaph.; absol.: Mk 16:20 (illustrated by use in verifying accounts; v. MM, Exp., xiv; Milligan; NTD, 78); c. dat. pers., of sins, I Ti 5:24 (cf. Ellic. and CGT, in l); τ. ἴχνεσιν, I Pe 2:21; ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ, I Ti 5:10.†

ἐπειδήπερ.as:
* ἐπει-δή-περ
conj.,
forasmuch as ("a stately compound," freq. in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): Lk 1:1.†

ἐπιχειρέω.sd: to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake
ἐπιχειρέω.as:
ἐπιχειρέω, -ῶ
(< χεῖρ), [in LXX for חָשַׁב, Ex 9:25; גָּמַל, II Ch 20:11, al. ;]
1.to pat one's hand to.
2.to take in hand, attempt: c. inf., Lk 1:1, Ac 9:2919:13.†

ἐπέρχομαι.long: I come to, arrive, come on, come upon, attack.
ἐπέρχομαι.sd: to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence
ἐπέρχομαι.as:
ἐπ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;]
1.to come to, arrive, come on: seq. ἀπό, c. gen. loc., Ac 14:19 (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, Pr., 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, Eph 2:7.
2.to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, Lk 21:26, Ac 8:2413:40, Ja 5:1; of an enemy, Lk 11:22; of the Holy Spirit, Lk 1:35, Ac 1:8, [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, Jg 14:6, III Ki 11:6, al.].†

ἐπιβλέπω.long: I look with favor on, regard.
ἐπιβλέπω.sd: to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality)
ἐπιβλέπω.kj: look upon, regard, have respect to
ἐπιβλέπω.as:
ἐπι-βλέπω
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;]
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX (I Ki 1:119:16, Ps 24(25):16; To 3:3, al.), to look on with favour: seq. ἐπί c. acc pers., Lk 1:489:38, Ja 2:3.†

ἐπιφαίνω.long: I appear (as of a light in the heavens or from the heavens), shine upon.
ἐπιφαίνω.sd: to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known
ἐπιφαίνω.as:
ἐπι-φαίνω
[in LXX for אוּר hi., etc. ;]
1.to show forth.
2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear: Ac 27:20; c. dat. pers., Lk 1:79; metaph., Tit 3:4; c. dat., ib. 2:11 (Cremer, 567).†

ἐπίκειμαι.long: (a) dat: I am placed upon, am laid upon, lie upon, am imposed; I press upon, (b) absol: I press hard, am insistent, insist.
ἐπίκειμαι.kj: impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon
ἐπίκειμαι.as:
ἐπι-κείμαι
[in LXX: Ex 36:40 (39:31) (נָתַן), Jb 19:3 (הָכַר hi.) 21:27 (חָמַס), I Mac 6:57, II Mac 1:21, III Mac 1:22 * ;]
to be placed, lie on: Jo 21:9; seq. ἐπί, c. dat., ib. 11:38; fig., He 9:10; ἀνάγκη, I Co 9:16; χειμῶν, to threaten, come on: Ac 27:20; of persons, to press upon: Lk 5:123:23.†

ἐπιστάτης.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G2476 (ἵστημι);
ἐπιστάτης.as:
ἐπιστάτης, -ου, ό
(< ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: IV Ki 25:19, Je 36(29):2652:25 (פָּקִיד), II Ch 31:12 (נָגִיד), II Mac 5:22, etc. ;]
a chief, commander, master: Lk 5:58:24, 459:33, 4917:13 (cf. Dalman, Words, 336 ff.).†

ἐπηρεάζω.long: I insult, treat wrongfully, molest, revile.
ἐπηρεάζω.der: from a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (probably) (threats);
ἐπηρεάζω.as:
* ἐπηρεάζω
(< ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse),
to revile: c. acc pers., Lk 6:28; c. acc rei (but v. ICC, in l.), I Pe 3:16.†

ἐπειδή.long: of time: when, now, after that; of cause: seeing that, forasmuch as.
ἐπειδή.sd: since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas
ἐπειδή.kj: after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since
ἐπειδή.as:
ἐπει-δή
conj.;
1. of time, when now, after that: Lk 7:1 (WH, txt.).
2. Of cause, seeing that, forasmuch as: Lk 11:6, Ac 13:46 (WH, txt., RV) Ac 14:1215:24, I Co 1:21, 2214:1615:21, Phl 2:26.†

ἐπιπορεύομαι.sd: to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach)
ἐπιπορεύομαι.as:
† ἐπι-πορεύομαι
[in LXX: Le 26:33 (אָחַר), Ez 39:14 (עָבַר), Ep. Je 62, II Mac 2:28, III Mac 1:4 * ;]
to travel, journey to: seq. πρός, c. acc pers., Lk 8:4.†

ἐπισιτισμός.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4621 (σῖτος);
ἐπισιτισμός.as:
ἐπισιτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἐπισιτίζομαι, to supply with provisions), [in LXX: Ge 42:25, al. (צֵדָה), Jth 2:184:5 ;]
1.a foraging.
2.provisions, food: Lk 9:12.†

ἐπαναπαύομαι.g: I rest upon, rely on, trust in
ἐπαναπαύομαι.long: I rest upon, rely on, trust in.
ἐπαναπαύομαι.sd: to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely)
ἐπαναπαύομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G373 (ἀναπαύω);
ἐπαναπαύομαι.as:
ἐπ-ανα-παύω
[in LXX, mid., for נוּחַ, שָׁעַן ni ;]
to refresh, cause to rest (upon); mid., to rest upon: metaph., c. dat., Ro 2:17; seq. ἐπί, c. acc, Lk 10:6 (Cremer, 827).†

ἐπιχέω.as:
ἐπι-χέω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַק. Ge 28:18, al. ;]
to pour upon: Lk 10:34.†

ἐπιβιβάζω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a reduplicated derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις) (compare G307 (ἀναβιβάζω));
ἐπιβιβάζω.as:
ἐπι-βιβάζω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;]
to place upon: c. acc pers., Lk 10:3419:35, Ac 23:24.†

ἐπιμελέομαι.g: I take care of, attend to
ἐπιμελέομαι.long: I take care of, attend to.
ἐπιμελέομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and the same as G3199 (μέλω);
ἐπιμελέομαι.as:
ἐπι-μελέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Ge 44:21 (עֵיוַיםשִׁים) I Es 6:27, Pr 27:25, Si 33:13 (30:25), I Mac 11:37 * ;]
to take care of: c. gen., Lk 10:34, 35, I Ti 3:5.†

ἐπανέρχομαι.sd: to come up on, i.e. return
ἐπανέρχομαι.as:
ἐπ-αν-έρχομαι
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;]
to return: Lk 10:3519:15.†

ἐπαθροίζομαι.g: I gather together, crowd upon, press around
ἐπαθροίζομαι.long: I gather together, pass: I crowd upon (some one), press around.

ἐπέχω.g: I hold forth, pay attention, note, delay
ἐπέχω.long: (a) trans: I hold forth, (b) intrans: I mark, pay attention (heed), note; I delay, stay, wait.
ἐπέχω.sd: to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of G3563 (νοῦς)) to pay attention to
ἐπέχω.kj: give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay
ἐπέχω.as:
ἐπ-έχω
[in LXX for חָדַל, etc.; also Si 8:131(34):2, II Mac 5:259:25, al. ;]
1.to hold upon.
2. Like παρέχω (as in Hom., al.), to hold out, offer: λόγον ζωῆς, Phl 2:16.
3.to hold or direct towards, Sc.νοῦν;
(a) absol., to intend, purpose;
(b)to observe, give attention to (v. MM, Exp., xiv): seq. πῶς, Lk 14:7; c. dat. pers., Ac 3:5, I Ti 4:16.
4.to stay, wait: Ac 19:22 (in legal phrase, MM, Exp., l.c.).†

ἐπιμελῶς.der: adverb from a derivative of G1959 (ἐπιμελέομαι);
ἐπιμελῶς.as:
ἐπιμελῶς
adv.,
[in LXX for רַק, etc. ;]
carefully: Lk 15:8.†

ἐπαιτέω.long: I beg, am a beggar, ask alms.
ἐπαιτέω.as:
ἐπ-αιτέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: Ps 108 (109):10 (H7592) Si 40:28 * ;]
1.to ask besides.
2.to beg (as a mendicant; cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Lk 16:318:35 (Cremer, 74).†

ἔπειτα.as:
ἔπειτα, adv. of sequence
[in LXX: Nu 19:10 A, Is 16:2, IV Mac 6:3 * ;]
thereupon, thereafter, then: Lk 16:7, Ga 1:21, Ja 4:14; seq. μετὰ τοῦτο, Jo 11:7; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, Ga 1:18; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, Ga 2:1; πρῶτον . . . ἔ., I Co 15:46, I Th 4:17, He 7:2; πρότεφον . . . ἔ, He 7:27; ἀπαρχὴ . . . ἔ., I Co 15:23; εἶτα . . . ἔ., I Co 15:5, 6 (WH, txt.); . . . ἔ., I Co 15:5-7 (WH, mg.); τρίτον . . . ἔ. (his), I Co 12:28.†

ἐπαινέω.as:
ἐπ-αινέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הָלַל pi., שָׁבַח pi. ;]
to praise: c. acc, Ro 15:11, I Co 11:22; seq. ὅτι, Lk 16:8, I Co 11:2; absol., seq. ὅτι, I Co 11:17.†

ἐπιλείχω.as:
† ἐπι-λείχω
to lick over: c. acc, Lk 16:21 (of. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπιρίπτω.as:
ἐπι-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, as in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;]
1.to cast at.
2.to cast or place upon: c. acc seq. ἐπί, c. acc, Lk 19:35; metaph., τ. μέριμναν, I Pe 5:7(LXX).†

ἐπισκοπή.sd: inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate"
ἐπισκοπή.kj: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation
ἐπισκοπή.as:
† ἐπι-σκοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiey for פָּקַדפְּקֻדָּה ;]
1.a visiting, visitation (εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after Heb.), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment (Le 19:20Jb 10:12, Je 6:15, Wi 2:20, al.): Lk 19:44, I Pe 2:12 (v. Hort, in l.).
2.office, charge, esp. office of anἐπίσκοιος (q.v.): Ac 1:20(LXX), I Ti 3:1 (Cremer, 527 f., 864; DCG, ii, 809 b).†

ἐπεισέρχομαι.long: I come to, arrive, come on, come upon, attack.
ἐπεισέρχομαι.sd: to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence
ἐπεισέρχομαι.as:
* ἐπ-εισ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: I Mac 16:16 (c. dat.) * ;]
to come in upon: seq. ἐπίLk 21:35.†

ἐπισχύω.long: I persist, insist, am more urgent.
ἐπισχύω.sd: to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly
ἐπισχύω.as:
** ἐπ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Si 29:1, I Mac 6:6 * ;]
1.to make stronger (Si, l.c.).
2.to grow stronger; metaph., be more urgent: Lk 23:5.†

ἐπιφωνέω.long: I call out, shout, clamor at.
ἐπιφωνέω.sd: to call at something, i.e. exclaim
ἐπιφωνέω.as:
** ἐπι-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Es 9:47 AR, II Mac 1:23, III Mac 7:13 * ;]
to call out, shout: c. acc rei, Ac 21:34; c. dat. pers., ib. 22:24; seq. λέγοντες, Lk 23:21; orat. rect., Ac 12:22.†

ἐπικρίνω.as:
** ἐπι-κρίνω
[in LXX: II Mac 4:47, III Mac 4:2 * ;]
to decree, give sentence: c. acc et inf., Lk 23:24.†

ἐπαγγελία.sd: an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good)
ἐπαγγελία.as:
ἐπ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπαγγέλλω), [in LXX: Ps 55(56):8 (סֵפֶר), etc. ;]
1.a summons (as Attic law-term, Dem., al.).
2.a promise (Dem., Arist., al.): Ac 23:21; esp. in NT of the divine promises, Ac 7:17, Ro 4:14, 169:4, Ga 3:17, 18, 214:23, He 8:611:9, 17, II Pe 3:9; c. inf., He 4:1; γίνεται, etc., c. dat. pers., Ac 2:39, Ro 4:13, Ga 3:16; seq. πρός, Ac 13:3226:6; έπαγγέλεσθαι τὴν ἐ., I Jo 2:25; ἔχειν ἐπαγγελίας, He 7:6, II Co 7:1; εἷναι νἐ έπαγγελίᾳ, Eph 6:2; ἡ γῆ τῆς ἐ., He 11:9; τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐ., Ro 9:8, Ga 4:28; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς ἐ. τ. ἅγιον, Eph 1:13; αἱ διαθῆκαι τῆς ἐ., Eph 2:12; ἡ ἐ. τ. θεοῦ, Ro 4:20; pl., II Co 1:20; αἱ ἐ. τ. πατέρων, Ro 15:8; c. gen. obj., τ. ζωῆς (v. Dalman, Words, 103), I Ti 4:8; τ. παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, II Pe 3:4; κατ ̓ ἐπαγγελίαν, Ac 13:23, Ga 3:29, II Ti 1:1; δι ̓ ἐπαγγελίας, Ga 3:18; συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐ., Eph 3:6; λόγος ἐπαγγελίας, Ro 9:9. By meton. (cf. ἐλπίς), of a promised blessing: Lk 24:49, Ac 1:14, Ga 3:22, He 6:12, 15, 1710:3611:13, 33, 39; c. gen. epexeg., Ac 2:33Ga 3:14, He 9:15 (Cremer, 27).†

ἐπίγειος.long: (a) on the earth, belonging to the earth (as opposed to the sky), (b) in a spiritual sense, belonging to the earthly sphere, earthly (as opposed to heavenly).
ἐπίγειος.as:
* ἐπί-γειος, -ον
(< ἐπί, γῆ),
of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., Jo 3:12Phl 2:103:19 (anarth.); σώματα, I Co 15:40; οἰκία, II Co 5:1; σοφία, Ja 3:15 (Cremer, 153).†

ἐπουράνιος.long: heavenly, celestial, in the heavenly sphere, the sphere of spiritual activities; met: divine, spiritual.
ἐπουράνιος.as:
ἐπουράνιος, -ον
(< οὐρανός), [in LXX: Ps 68:14 (שַׁדַּי), Da TH 4:23 A (שָׁמַיִם) II Mac 3:39, III Mac 6:287:6, IV Mac 4:11 AR, IV Mac 11:3א* ;]
in or of heaven, heavenly (in Hom., of the Gods): οἱ ἐ., opp. to ἐπίγειοι and καταχθόνιοι, Phl 2:10; to χοϊκός, I Co 15:48, 49; σώματα (v. Lft., Col., 376), I Co 15:40; βασιλεία, II Ti 4:18; παπρίς, He 11:16; Ἱερουσαλήμ, He 12:22; κλῆσις (cf. Lft. on Phl 3:14), He 3:1; τὰ ἐ., He 8:59:23; opp. to ἐπίγειος, Jo 3:12; id., of the heavenly regions, Eph 1:3, 202:63:106:12; ἡ δωρεὰ ἡ ἐ., He 6:4 (Cremer, 468).†

ἐπιλέγω.g: I call, choose for myself, am named
ἐπιλέγω.long: I call; mid: I choose for myself; pass: I am named.
ἐπιλέγω.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G3004 (λέγω);
ἐπιλέγω.as:
ἐπι-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
1.to say in addition (Hdt.).
2.to call by name, to call: Jo 5:2.
3.to choose; mid., to choose for oneself: Ac 15:40.†

ἐπάρατος.as:
* ἐπ-άρατος, -ον
(< ἐπαράομαι, to imprecate),
accursed: Jo 7:49 (for exx. from π., v. MM, Exp., xiv; cf. Cremer, 108).†

ἐπιχρίω.as:
** ἐπι-χρίω
[in Sm.: Ez 13:1022:28 * ;]
to spread on, anoint: c. acc, Jo 9:11; id. seq. ἐπί, c. acc, Jo 9:6 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπενδύτης.long: a coat, outer wrap or tunic.
ἐπενδύτης.as:
ἐπενδύτης, -ου, ὁ
(< ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִילLe 8:7 A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), I Ki 18:4 A, II Ki 13:18 * ;]
an outer tunic (RV, coat): Jo 21:7 .†

ἔπαυλις.sd: a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling
ἔπαυλις.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and an equivalent of G833 (αὐλή);
ἔπαυλις.as:
ἔπ-αυλις, -εως, ἡ
(< αὐλή), [in LXX for חָצֵר, טִירָה, (l.c.), etc. ;]
a dwelling, habitation: Ac 1:20(LXX).†

ἐπιδημέω.long: I sojourn, am resident (temporarily, in a foreign city).
ἐπιδημέω.sd: to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country)
ἐπιδημέω.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1218 (δῆμος);
ἐπιδημέω.as:
* ἐπι-δημέω, -ῶ
(< δῆμος);
1.to be at home (Thuc., Plat., al.),
2.to stay in a place, sojourn (Plat., Xen., al.; and v. MM, Exp., xiv): Ac 2:1017:21; seq. ἐν, ib. 18:27 (WH, mg.).†

ἐπιφανής.as:
ἐπιφανής, -ές
(< ἐπιφαίνω), [in LXX (v. Thayer, s.v.) for יָרֵא, etc., Jg 13:6, Jl 2:11, 31 al.; II Mac 6:23, III Mac 5:35, al. ;]
renowned, illustrious, notable: Ac 2:20(LXX) (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπάγω.long: I bring upon; met: I cause to be imputed to.
ἐπάγω.sd: to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime)
ἐπάγω.as:
ἐπ-άγω
[in LXX for בּוֹא hi., etc. (29 words in all) ;]
to bring upon: c. dat. et acc, II Pe 2:5; ἑαυτοῖς ἐ. (for cl. mid., v. Mayor, in l), II Pe 2:1; ἐ. τὸ αἷμα (cf. Ge 20:9), Ac 5:28.†

ἔπειμι.sd: supervening, i.e. (G2250 (ἡμέρα) or G3571 (νύξ) being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night
ἔπειμι.der: feminine singular participle of a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to go);
ἔπειμι.as:
ἔπ-ειμι
[in LXX: Ex 8:22(18) (עָמַד), Si 42:19, etc. ;]
1.to come upon, approach
2. Of time, to come on or after; mostly as ptcp., ἐπιών, -οῦσα, όν, next, following: τῇ- ἔ. (sc. ἡμέρᾳ, as freq. in late Gk.), Ac 16:1120:1521:18; ἡμέρᾳ (as usual in cl.), Ac 7:26; νυκτί, Ac 23:11.†

ἐπέκεινα.sd: upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of
ἐπέκεινα.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565 (ἐκεῖνος);
ἐπέκεινα.as:
ἐπ-έκεινα
adv.
(= ἐπ’ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: Le 22:27, Nu 32:19, al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;]
beyond; c. gen., Ac 7:43(LXX) †

ἐπίθεσις.long: a laying on; an attack, assault.
ἐπίθεσις.as:
ἐπί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: II Ch 25:27 (קֶשֶׁר), Ez 23:11 (עֲגָבָה) II Mac 4:415:514:15 * ;]
1.a laying on: χειρῶν, Ac 8:18, I Ti 4:14, II Ti 1:6, He 6:2 (cf. Westc., He., l.c.; CGT on 1Ti, l.c.).
2.an attack, assault (II Mac, ll.c.).†

ἐπίνοια.sd: attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose
ἐπίνοια.as:
ἐπίνοια, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπινοέω, to contrive) [in LXX: Je 20:10, Wi 6:169:1414:1215:4, Si 40:2, II Mac 12:45, IV Mac 17:2 * ;]
a thought, design: Ac 8:22.†

ἐπιστολή.as:
ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; freq. in Mac ;]
1.a message.
2.a letter, an epistle: Ac 9:2, I Co 5:9, al.; pl., Ac 22:5, I Co 16:3, al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, II Co 3:1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, Th., 121 ff.; NTD, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.)

ἐπιβουλή.sd: a plan against someone, i.e. a plot
ἐπιβουλή.der: from a presumed compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1014 (βούλομαι);
ἐπιβουλή.as:
ἐπι-βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Es 2:22, I Es 5:73, II Mac 5:7, al. ;]
a plan against, a plot: Ac 9:2420:3, 1923:30.†

ἐπιμένω.long: (a) I remain, tarry, (b) I remain in, persist in.
ἐπιμένω.sd: to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere)
ἐπιμένω.as:
ἐπι-μένω
[in LXX: Ex 12:39 (מָהַהּ hith.)* ;]
to stay on, tarry or abide still: seq. έν, I Co 16:8; αὐτοῦ, there, Ac 15:34 (WH, txt., RV, txt., omit) 21:4; c. dat., τ. σαρκί, Phl 1:24; seq. παρά, c. dat. pers., Ac 28:14; πρός, c. acc pers., I Co 16:7, Ga 1:18; c. acc temp., Ac 10:4821:4, 1028:12, 14, I Co 16:7. Metaph., to continue in a pursuit or state: c. dat., τ. ἀμαρτίᾳ, Ro 6:1; τ. ὰπιστίᾳ, 11:23; τ. πίστει, Col 1:23; αὐτοῖς (v. CGT, in l), I Ti 4:16; τ. χρηστότητι, Ro 11:22; c. ptcp. (cf. Bl., § 73, 4; 76, 2), Jo 8:7, Ac 12:16.†

ἐπεγείρω.sd: to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against
ἐπεγείρω.as:
ἐπ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר hi., קוּם hi., etc. ;]
to rouse up, excite: c. acc rei, διωγμόν, Ac 13:50; ψυχάς, Ac 14:2.†

ἐπιστηρίζω.long: I prop up, uphold, support, confirm, make stronger.
ἐπιστηρίζω.as:
ἐπι-στηρίζω
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;]
to make stronger, confirm: c. acc, Ac 14:2215:32, 41.†

ἐπιστροφή.as:
ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: Ez 47:7 (שׁוּב), Si 18:2149:2, etc. ;]
a turning about; metaph., conversion (Field, Notes, 246): Ac 15:3.†

ἐπιστέλλω.g: I write, send by letter to.
ἐπιστέλλω.sd: to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose)
ἐπιστέλλω.as:
ἐπι-στέλλω
[in LXX: III Ki 5:8(22)Ne 6:19 (שָׁלַח), Jth 15:4, I Mac 10:2512:713:18 (in each case with v.l. ἀποσ-) * ;]
1.to send to.
2.to send a message by letter, to write word (MM, Exp., xiv): c. dat. pers., Ac 21:25, He 13:22; seq. τοῦ, c. inf., Ac 15:20.†

ἐπάναγκες.der: neuter of a presumed compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G318 (ἀνάγκη);
ἐπάναγκες.as:
* ἐπανάγκης, -ες
(< ἀνάγκη), only in neut.;
1.ἐπάναγκες (sc. ἐστί), it is compulsory, necessary.
2. As adv., of necessity: Ac 15:28.†

ἐπακροάομαι.long: I listen to, hear, hearken to.
ἐπακροάομαι.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G202 (ἀκροατής);
ἐπακροάομαι.as:
* ἐπ-ακροάομαι, -ῶμαι
to listen attentively: Ac 16:25 (cf. Page, in l).†

Ἐπικούρειος.long: an Epicurean, one who holds the tenets of Epicurus.
Ἐπικούρειος.sd: an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus
Ἐπικούρειος.as:
† Ἐπικούριος (Rec. -ειος), -ου, ὁ
an Epicurean, a follower of Epicurus: Ac 17:18.†

ἐπινεύω.long: I nod to, assent to, consent.
ἐπινεύω.sd: to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent
ἐπινεύω.as:
ἐπι-νεύω
[in LXX: Pr 26:24 (נָכַר ni.), I Mac 6:57, II Mac 4:1011:1514:20 * ;]
to nod in command or approval, to nod approval, consent: Ac 18:20.†

ἐπίσκοπος.long: (used as an official title in civil life), overseer, supervisor, ruler, especially used with reference to the supervising function exercised by an elder or presbyter of a church or congregation.
ἐπίσκοπος.sd: a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively)
ἐπίσκοπος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4649 (σκοπός) (in the sense of G1983 (ἐπισκοπέω));
ἐπίσκοπος.as:
ἐπί-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
(< σκοπός, a watcher), [in LXX for פָּקַד, its parts and derivatives, Nu 4:1631:14, Jg 9:28, IV Ki 11:15, 18, II Ch 34:12, 17, Ne 11:9, 14, 22; אֵל, Jb 20:29; נוֹגַשׂ:, Is 60:17; Wi 1:6, I Mac 1:51 * ;]
a superintendent, guardian, overseer (cl.; for exx. v. LS, s.v.): Ac 20:28, I Pe 2:25 (ICC, in l.); as technical term for a religious office (Deiss., BS, 230 f.), in later Paul. epp. of the head of a church (Vg. episcopus), a bishop: Phl 1:1, I Ti 3:2, Tit 1:7 (v. reff. s.v. ἐπισκοπή).†

ἐπισκευάζομαι.as:
ἐπι-σκευάζω
[in LXX for חזק pi., etc.;]
to equip, make ready ; mid., to make one’s preparations : Ac 21:15.†

ἐπαρχεία.sd: a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture
ἐπαρχεία.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G757 (ἄρχω) (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch");
ἐπαρχεία.as:
† ἐπαρχεία (Rec. -χία, v. Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(< ἔπαρχος, a prefect), [in LXX: Es 4:11 (מְדִינָה), Jth 3:6 A* ;]
the jurisdiction of a prefect, a province: Ac 23:3425:1.†

ἐπίστασις.as:
** ἐπί-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: II Mac 6:3 * ;]
1.a stopping, halting (as of soldiers): ὄχλου, collecting a crowd (v. Rack-ham, Acts, l.c.): Ac 24:12 (WH, Rec. ἐπισύστασις).
2.superintendence, attention (but v. Thayer, s.v.; Field, Notes, 185 f.): II Co 11:28 (WH, Rec. ut supr.).†

ἐπιτροπή.as:
** ἐπι-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: II Mac 13:14 * ;]
power to decide, authority: Ac 26:12.†

ἐπικουρία.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and a (prolonged) form of the base of G2877 (κοράσιον) (in the sense of servant);
ἐπικουρία.as:
** ἐπικουρία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπικουρέω to be an ἐπίκουρος, an ally) [in LXX: Wi 13:18 * ;]
aid, assistance: Ac 26:22.†

ἐπιμέλεια.as:
ἐπιμέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπιμελέομαι), [in LXX: Pr 3:8 (שִׁקּוּי), Wi 13:13, I Es 6:10, I Mac 16:14, al. ;]
attention, care: Ac 27:3 (v. Field, Notes, 143).†

ἐπισφαλής.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to trip);
ἐπισφαλής.as:
** ἐπισφαλής, -ές
(< σφάλλω, to cause to fall), [in LXX: Wi 9:14 (cf. -ῶς, ib. 4:4) * ;]
1.prone to fall (Plat.).
2.dangerous (Hipp., Plut., al.): Ac 27:9.†

ἐπικέλλω.long: I force forward, run (a ship) aground.
ἐπικέλλω.sd: to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel
ἐπικέλλω.as:
* ἐπι-κέλλω
of a ship, to run ashore: c. acc, Ac 27:41.†

ἐπιγίνομαι.long: I arise, spring up, arrive, come on.
ἐπιγίνομαι.sd: to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind)
ἐπιγίνομαι.as:
** ἐπι-γίνομαι (v.s. γίνομαι)
[in LXX: Ep. Je 47, III Mac 2:6 * ;]
to arrive, arise, come on: Ac 28:13.†

ἐπιποθέω.g: I long for, strain after, desire greatly
ἐπιποθέω.long: I long for, strain after, desire greatly, have affection for.
ἐπιποθέω.sd: to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully)
ἐπιποθέω.as:
ἐπι-ποθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for יָאַב, אָרַג, כָּסַף hi., etc. ;]
to long for, desire: c. inf., Ro 1:11, II Co 5:2, I Th 3:6, II Ti 1:4, Phl 2:26 (WH, [txt.]); c. acc rei, I Pe 2:2; c. acc pers., II Co 9:14, Phl 1:82:26 (WH, mg); absol., Ja 4:5 (v. Mayor, in l.).†

ἐπίγνωσις.long: knowledge of a particular point (directed towards a particular object); perception, discernment, recognition, intuition.
ἐπίγνωσις.sd: recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement
ἐπίγνωσις.as:
† ἐπί-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἐπιγινώσκω, q.v.), [in LXX: III Ki 7:14 (B. γν-), Pr 2:5, Ho 4:1, 66:7(6) (דַּעַת), Jth 9:14, II Mac 9:11 * ;]
acquaintance, discernment, recognition (Plut., al.): Phl 1:9, Col 3:10; c. gen. rei, Col 1:92:2, Phm 6; τ. ἀληθείας, I Ti 2:4, II Ti 2:253:7, Tit 1:1, He 10:26; τ. ἁμαρτίας, Ro 3:20; c. gen. pers., of God: Eph 1:17, Col 1:10, II Pe 1:2, 3; of Christ: Eph 4:13, II Pe 1:82:20; of God and Christ: II Pe 1:2; κατ ̓ ἐ., Ro 10:2; ἔχειν ἐν ἐ., Ro 1:28 (v. AR, Eph., 248 ff.; and for a somewhat different view, Thayer, s.v.; Lft. on Col, 1:9; Tr., Syn., lxxv; Cremer, 159 f.; cf. αἴσθησις).†

ἐπονομάζομαι.g: I name, impose a name on
ἐπονομάζομαι.long: I name, impose a name on; pass: am named.
ἐπονομάζομαι.as:
ἐπ-ονομάζω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to name, call by a name, surname: pass., Ro 2:17.†

ἔπαινος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G134 (αἰνέω);
ἔπαινος.as:
ἔπ-αινος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for תְּהִלָּה, etc. ;]
praise: Ro 2:29Ro 13:3, I Co 4:5, II Co 8:18, Eph 1:6, 12, 14, Phl 1:114:8, I Pe 1:72:14.†

ἐπιφέρω.sd: to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce
ἐπιφέρω.as:
ἐπι-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;]
1.to bring upon or against: κρίσιν, Ju 9.
2.to impose, inflict: Ro 3:5.†

ἐπικαλύπτω.long: I put a cover on, cover up.
ἐπικαλύπτω.as:
ἐπι-καλύπτω
[in LXX for כָּסָה, etc. ;]
to cover over, cover up: metaph., Ro 4:7(LXX).†

ἐπιτυγχάνω.sd: to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain
ἐπιτυγχάνω.as:
ἐπι-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Ge 39:2 (צָלַח hi.), Pr 12:27 (חָרַךְ)* ;]
1.to light upon.
2.to obtain, attain to: Ja 4:2, c. gen. rei (as in cl.), He 6:1511:33; c. acc (late Gk.), Ro 11:7 (Rec. τούτου).†

ἐπαναμιμνῄσκω.long: I remind, possibly: I remind again.
ἐπαναμιμνῄσκω.as:
* ἐπ-ανα-μιμνήσκω
to remind again: c. acc pers., Ro 15:15.†

ἐπιτελέω.sd: to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo
ἐπιτελέω.as:
ἐπι-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for כָּלָה, עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
to complete, accomplish, execute: c. acc rei, Ro 15:28, II Co 7:18:6, 11, Phl 1:6, He 8:5; of religious services (cf. Hdt., ii, 37, al.), He 9:6; art. inf., II Co 8:11. Mid.,
(a)to complete for oneself, make an end (R, mg.; pass., R, txt; cf. Meyer, in l): Ga 3:3;
(b)to pay in full, pay the tax, be subject to: c. acc (cf. Xen., Mem., iv, 8, 8), I Pe 5:9 (pass., RV, etc.; cf. Thayer, s.v.; ICC, in 1).†

Ἐπαίνετος.as:
Ἐπαίνετος (Rec. -τός), -ου, ὁ
Epænetus, a Christian of Rome: Ro 16:5.†

ἐποικοδομέω.sd: to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up
ἐποικοδομέω.as:
* ἐπ-οικοδομέω, -ῶ
in NT, always metaph., of the spiritual life regarded as a building (Cremer, 449);
1.to build upon: I Co 3:10, 12, 14; pass., Eph 2:20.
2.to build up: Col 2:7, I Pe 2:5 (T, οἰκοδ- WH, Rec.), Ju 20.†

ἐπιθανάτιος.g: at the point of death, condemned to death
ἐπιθανάτιος.long: at the point of death, condemned to death.
ἐπιθανάτιος.as:
** ἐπιθανάτιος, -ον
[in LXX: Da Bel 31 ;]
condemned to death: I Co 4:9.†

ἐπιταγή.sd: an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness
ἐπιταγή.as:
† ἐπι-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐπιτάσσω), [in LXX: Da LXX 3:16 (פִּתְגָּם), I Es 1:18, Wi 14:1618:1619:6, III Mac 7:20 * ;]
= cl., ἐπίταγμα,
a command, Ro 16:26, I Co 7:6, 25, II Co 8:8, I Ti 1:1, Tit 1:3 (for use in Inscr. of divine commands, v. MM, Exp., xiv); μετὰ πάσης ἐ, with all authority: Tit 2:15.†

ἐπισπάομαι.long: (lit: I draw over), mid: I become as uncircumcised.
ἐπισπάομαι.sd: to draw over, i.e. (with G203 (ἀκροβυστία) implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin)
ἐπισπάομαι.as:
ἐπι-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Is 5:18 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw on: mid., in peculiar sense of effacing signs of Judaism (cf. I Mac 1:15, FlJ, Ant., xii, 5, i; v. Thayer, s.v.), to become as uncircumcised: I Co 7:18.†

ἐπιθυμητής.as:
ἐπιθυμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἐπιθυμέω) [in LXX: Nu 11:34 (אָוָה hithp.); εἶναι ἐ., Pr 1:22 (חָמַד)* ;]
one longing for, lustful after: κακῶν, I Co 10:6.†

ἐπιβαρέω.long: I put a burden on, am burdensome.
ἐπιβαρέω.sd: to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards
ἐπιβαρέω.as:
† ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ
to put a burden on, be burdensome: fig., absol., II Co 2:5; c. acc pers., I Th 2:9, II Th 3:8 (cf. M, Th., I, 2:9).†

ἐπιτιμία.sd: properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of G2008 (ἐπιτιμάω)) of a penalty
ἐπιτιμία.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G5092 (τιμή);
ἐπιτιμία.as:
ἐπιτιμία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπιτιμάω), [in LXX: Wis_3:10 * ;]
1.citizenship, franchise.
2. As in Inscr. (LS, s.v.), LXX, l.c. (= cl. τὸ ἐπιτίμιον), punishment, penalty: II Co 2:6.†

ἐπενδύομαι.long: I have on over (as a garment); mid: I put on myself in addition.
ἐπενδύομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1746 (ἐνδύω);
ἐπενδύομαι.as:
*† ἐπ-εν-δύω
= -δύνω (Hdt.),
to put on over; pass. (Plut., al.), to have on over, be clothed upon: II Co 5:2, 4.†

ἐπακούω.as:
ἐπ-ακούω
[in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה, etc. ;]
1.to listen to.
2.to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): c. gen. pers., II Co 6:2(LXX).†

ἐπιπόθησις.as:
**† ἐπι-πόθησις, -εως, ἡ
[in Aq.: Ez 23:11 * ;]
longing: II Co 7:7, 11.†

ἐπιχορηγέω.sd: to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute
ἐπιχορηγέω.as:
** ἐπι-χορηγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Si 25:22, II Mac 4:9 A * ;]
to supply, provide: c. acc rei, II Pe 1:5; id. c. dat. pers., II Co 9:10, Ga 3:5; pass., Col 2:19, II Pe 1:11 (cf. χορηγέω, and v. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπισκηνόω.g: I raise a tent over, dwell
ἐπισκηνόω.long: I raise a tent (over), dwell, spread a tabernacle over.
ἐπισκηνόω.sd: to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with
ἐπισκηνόω.as:
*† ἐπι-σκηνόω, -ῶ
to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over: metaph., seq. ἐπ’ ἐμέ (RV, rest upon, cover), II Co 12:9.†

ἐπικατάρατος.long: on whom a curse has been invoked, accursed, doomed to destruction.
ἐπικατάρατος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G2672 (καταράομαι);
ἐπικατάρατος.as:
† ἐπι-κατ-άρατος, -ον
(< ἐπικαταράομαι, to imprecate curses on), [in LXX for אָרוּר, also Wi 3:1214:8, IV Mac 2:19 ;]
accursed: Ga 3:10(LXX)13(LXX κεκαταραμένος) (Cremer, 109).†

ἐπιδιατάσσομαι.long: I make an additional testamentary disposition, I furnish with additions.
ἐπιδιατάσσομαι.sd: to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil)
ἐπιδιατάσσομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1299 (διατάσσω);
ἐπιδιατάσσομαι.as:
*† ἐπι-δια-τάσσομαι
to add provisions to a document: Ga 3:15 (cf. ἐπιδιαθήκη, a second will, F1J, BJ, ii, 2, 3; the word is used of wills in π., cf. Deiss., LAE, 87).†

ἐπιχορηγία.as:
*† ἐπι-χορηγία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπιχορηγέω),
a supply: Eph 4:16, Phl 1:19.†

ἐπιδύω.long: I sink, set, set during, go down.
ἐπιδύω.as:
ἐπι-δύω
[in LXX: De 24:15, Jos 8:29, Je 15:9 (בּוֹא)* ;]
to go down, set (of the sun): Eph 4:26.†

ἐπιφαύσκω.g: I shine upon, give light to
ἐπιφαύσκω.long: I shine upon, give light to.
ἐπιφαύσκω.as:
† ἐπι-φαύσκω
(variant form of ἐπιφώσκω, q.v.), [in LXX: Jb 25:5 (אהל hi.) 31:2641:9(10) (הָלַל hi.) * ;]
to shine forth: fig., c. dat., Eph 5:14 (on v.l. -ψαύσει, v. ICC, Westc., AR, in l.).†

Ἐπαφρόδιτος.long: Epaphras, Epaphroditus, a Colossian Christian, in captivity with Paul in Rome.
Ἐπαφρόδιτος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) (in the sense of devoted to) and (Venus);

ἐπεκτείνομαι.der: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1614 (ἐκτείνω);
ἐπεκτείνομαι.as:
* ἐπ-εκ-τείνω
to extend: mid., to stretch forward: c. dat., Phl 3:13.†

ἐπιπόθητος.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the latter part of G1971 (ἐπιποθέω);

ἐπιεικής.long: gentle, mild, forbearing, fair, reasonable, moderate.
ἐπιεικής.as:
ἐπιεικής, -ές
(< εἰκός, likely), [in LXX: Ps 85(86):5 (סַלָּח), Es 8:13 * ;]
1.seemly, fitting (Hom.).
2.equitable, fair, moderate: I Ti 3:3, Tit 3:2, I Pe 2:18, Ja 3:17; τὸ ἐ. (Thuc., i, 76), Phl 4:5 (cf. Mayor, Ja, l.c., and v.s. ἐπιεικία).†
ἐπιείκεια v.s. ἐπιεικία

Ἐπαφρᾶς.long: Epaphras, Epaphroditus, a Colossian Christian, in captivity with Paul in Rome.

ἐπισυναγωγή.sd: a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship)
ἐπισυναγωγή.as:
**† ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: II Mac 2:7 * ;]
a gathering together, assembly: He 10:25; seq. ἐπί, II Th 2:1 (cf. II Mac, l.c.).†

ἐπιφάνεια.sd: a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future)
ἐπιφάνεια.as:
ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
(< ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: II Ki 7:23 (נוֹרָא), Es 5:1, Am 5:22, II Mac 2:213:245:412:2214:1615:27, III Mac 2:95:8, 51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., freq. of deities, v. MM, Exp., xiv)
a manifestation, appear­ance: II Th 2:8, I Ti 6:14, II Ti 1:104:1, 8, Tit 2:13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†

ἐπίορκος.as:
ἐπί-ορκος, -ον
[in LXX: Za 5:3 (שָׁבַע ni.) * ;]
1. of oaths, sworn falsely.
2. Of persons, perjured; as subst., a perjurer, false swearer: I Ti 1:10.†

ἐπιπλήσσω.long: I rebuke, chide, reprove, strike at.
ἐπιπλήσσω.sd: to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid
ἐπιπλήσσω.as:
* ἐπι-πλήσσω
1.to strike at, to punish.
2.to rebuke, reprove: I Ti 5:1.†

ἐπαρκέω.g: I aid, relieve, do service, render help
ἐπαρκέω.long: I aid, relieve, do service, render help, am strong enough for.
ἐπαρκέω.as:
** ἐπ-αρκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Mac 8:2611:35 * ;]
1.to be strong enough for.
2.to ward off.
3.to aid, relieve: c. dat. pers., I Ti 5:10, 16 (mid., WH, mg.).†

ἐπανόρθωσις.sd: a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation)
ἐπανόρθωσις.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G461 (ἀνορθόω);
ἐπανόρθωσις.as:
** ἐπ-αν-όρθωσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἐπανορθόω, to correct, restore; cf. II Mac 2:22) [in LXX: I Es 8:52, I Mac 14:34 * ;]
correction: of life, II Ti 3:16 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπισωρεύω.g: I heap up, obtain a multitude of
ἐπισωρεύω.long: I heap up, obtain a multitude of.
ἐπισωρεύω.sd: to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally
ἐπισωρεύω.as:
**† ἐπι-σωρεύω
[in Sm.: Jb 14:17, Ca 2:4 * ;]
to heap together; metaph., διδασκάλους, II Ti 4:3.†

ἐπιδιορθόω.long: I set in order besides, put in order, correct.
ἐπιδιορθόω.sd: to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally
ἐπιδιορθόω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός);
ἐπιδιορθόω.as:
*† ἐπι-δι-ορθόω
to set in order further: Tit 1:5 (Inscr.; Cremer, 808).†

ἐπιστομίζω.long: I muzzle, silence, stop the mouth.
ἐπιστομίζω.sd: to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence
ἐπιστομίζω.as:
* ἐπι-στομίζω
(< στόμα),
to bridle; metaph., to stop the mouth, to silence: Tit 1:11.†

ἔπος.as:
ἔπος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: Za 7:3, Si 44:5 * ;]
a word: ὡς ἔ. εἰπεῖν (cl.), so to speak: He 7:9.†
SYN.: λόγος, reasoned speech; ῥῆμα, mere articulated utterance; ἔ., the articulated expression of a thought

ἐπεισαγωγή.long: bringing in (besides or in addition), introduction, importation.
ἐπεισαγωγή.der: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1521 (εἰσάγω);
ἐπεισαγωγή.as:
* ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): He 7:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

ἐπιλείπω.sd: to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for
ἐπιλείπω.as:
ἐπι-λείπω
[in LXX: Ob 5א1 R (שָׁאַר hi.) * ;]
to fail: c. acc pers., He 11:32.†

ἐπισκοπέω.long: I exercise oversight, care for, visit.
ἐπισκοπέω.sd: to oversee; by implication, to beware
ἐπισκοπέω.as:
ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;]
1.to look upon, observe, examine: seq. μή, He 12:15.
2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: I Pe 5:2 (R, txt.; WH om.; Cremer, 527).†

ἐπιλησμονή.as:
**† ἐπι-λησμονή, -ῆς, ή
(< επιλήθω), [in LXX: Si 11:27 * ;]
forgetful­ness: ἀκροατὴς ἐ. (gen. of qual.), Ja 1:25.†

ἐπιτήδειος.as:
ἐπιτήδειος, -α, -ον
[in LXX: I Ch 28:2, Wi 4:5, I Mac 4:46, al. ;]
1.suitable, convenient,
2.useful, necessary: τὰ ἐ., necessaries, Ja 2:16,†

ἐπιστήμων.as:
ἐπιστήμων, -ον, gen., -ονoς
(ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: De 1:134:6, Is 5:21 (בִּין ni.), I Es 8:44, Si 10:2521:15, etc. ;]
knowing, skilled: Ja 3:13.†

ἐποπτεύω.g: I am an eyewitness of, behold
ἐποπτεύω.long: I am an eyewitness of, behold, look upon.
ἐποπτεύω.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
ἐποπτεύω.as:
** ἐπ-οπτεύω
[in Sm.: Ps 9:35 (10:14)32 (33:13) * ;]
to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. c.), look upon: I Pe 2:123:2.†

ἐπικάλυμμα.as:
ἐπι-κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(< ἐπικαλύπτω), [in LXX: Ex 26:1439:21(34), (מְכַסֶּה), IV Ki 17:19 (מָסָךְ), Jb 19:29 (aliter in Heb.)* ;]
a cover, veil: metaph., τ. κακίας, I Pe 2:16.†

ἐπερώτημα.long: inquiry, request, appeal, demand; a profession, pledge.
ἐπερώτημα.as:
** ἐπ-ερώτημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Da TH 4:14 (שְׁאֵלָא), Si 36(33):3 * ;]
1.a question, an inquiry (Hdt., Thuc.).
2.a demand: I Pe 3:21 (v. ICC, in l).†

ἐπίλοιπος.long: remaining, that is left over, still left.
ἐπίλοιπος.as:
ἐπί-λοιπος, -ον
(< λοιπός), [in LXX for יָתַר, שָׁאַר ;]
still left, remaining: χρόνος, I Pe 4:2.†

ἐπιμαρτυρέω.long: I testify earnestly, bear witness to.
ἐπιμαρτυρέω.as:
* ἐπι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
to bear witness to: c. acc et. inf., I Pe 5:12,†

ἐπάγγελμα.sd: a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good)
ἐπάγγελμα.as:
* ἐπ-άγγελμα, -τος, τό
(< ἐπαγγέλλω),
a promise: II Pe 1:43:13.†

ἐπόπτης.der: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
ἐπόπτης.as:
** ἐπόπτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX (of God): Es 5:1, II Mac 3:397:35, III Mac 2:21 * ;]
1.an overseer (LXX, ll. c.).
2.a spectator: II Pe 1:16 (of ἐ. as applied to God, v. parallels in Inscr., MM, Exp., xiv; of the use of this term in the mysteries, v. Mayor on II Pe, l.c.; Thayer, s.v.).†

ἐπίλυσις.as:
** ἐπί-λυσις -εως, ἡ
(< ἐπιλύω), [in Aq.: Ge 40:8; Sm.: Ho 3:4 * ;]
1.release.
2.solution, interpretation: II Pe 1:20.†

ἐπιδέχομαι.sd: to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher)
ἐπιδέχομαι.as:
** ἐπι-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Jth 13:13 B2, I Mac 10:114:23, Si 51:26, al. ;]
1. in cl., of things, to allow of, admit of (Dem., Arist., al.). In late writers,
2.to accept besides (Polyb.), to accept; (in π. of the terms of a lease; v. ICC, on III Jo, l.c.): III Jo 9.
3. (a) to receive besides (Menand.);
(b)to receive hospitably (I Mac, Si, ll c.): III Jo 10†

ἐπαγωνίζομαι.as:
ἐπ-αγωνίζομαι depon.;
1.to contend with (Plut.).
2.to contend for (C.I., 2335, 19): c. dat. rei, Ju 3.†

ἐπαφρίζω.long: I foam out (a metaphor from the seaweed and refuse borne on the crest of waves), vomit forth.
ἐπαφρίζω.sd: to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion)
ἐπαφρίζω.as:
ἐπ-αφρίζω
to foam up: metaph., τ. αἰσχύνας, Ju 13.†
